#### Migrate to Azure App Testing  
  
To avoid service disruptions, users should migrate existing Playwright workloads to Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid service disruptions  

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Azure updates](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/?id=499860)
